summary.headline: Astrological Chapter Catalogue
summary.text: Catalog of missing and surviving chapters in an Angelican astrological codex, covering the twelve houses, horoscopes, earthquakes, inquiries, rulers and kingdoms, high priests, ships, solar and lunar eclipses, nativity, star configurations, and embryonic development. Cross-references cite codices Vindobonensis 4 and Venetus 5.
